$note: Sync stamp for the vendored KnowledgeNetwork Design System snapshot. The DS is a Claude Design project with NO native version/release and NO per-file hashes in its manifest, so this file IS the diffable version marker of what state we adopted. To check for drift: re-read the DS via /design-sync, re-hash, and compare against `tokens.files` below; to adopt a change, re-vendor and update the hashes + syncedAt here. Graduating to a properly published/semver'd dependency is tracked in issue #66.

Hashes below are the last-verified DS fingerprints; re-read the DS via /design-sync to detect further DS changes. 2026-08-05 re-sync: colors.css adopted contrast pass; 2026-08-08: typography.css adopted the 2026-08-05 DS addition (--ls-caps: 0.12em added, --ls-eyebrow aliased to it — every all-caps string in the system carries --ls-caps, a system-level rule not a per-component one). 2026-08-09 re-sync: all 7 files re-hashed and the recipe pinned down (see hashRecipe) — base/colors/elevation/fonts/motion reproduce their recorded fingerprints exactly, so they are unchanged and verbatim; typography.css is byte-identical to the DS and its NEEDS_RECOMPUTE marker is now a real hash. spacing.css keeps a LOCAL deviation, but the reason has INVERTED: the DS removed the dead --road-question-h / --road-tab-h (we converge) and corrected --road-head-h 28px -> 44px explicitly to adopt our old local value, except that value is now one revision stale — #70/#86 (2d59ac3) added the description row and grew the title, so AuthorRoad.tsx:84 headH() = HEAD_TITLE(28) + HEAD_DESC(20) + HEAD_COMBO(24) = 72px. We hold 72px; the road owns its own constants. Do NOT adopt 44 back. Re-reported on drift-log #74.
tokens.hashRecipe: sha256 of the file's bytes with CRLF normalized to LF. This repo has core.autocrlf=true, so the working tree is CRLF while git blobs and the DS originals are LF — hashing the working-tree file raw yields a machine-local fingerprint that will never match the DS. Verify the recipe before trusting a mismatch: `tr -d '\r' < src/tokens/base.css | sha256sum` must reproduce base.css below.
